summary: Peer-to-peer accommodation network — host-guest trust infrastructure and inventory breadth create a durable marketplace moat.
moat: Airbnb's moat is its double-sided marketplace with 7 million+ active listings tied to host identities with verified review histories accumulated over years. A host's Superhost status and review portfolio represent real-world reputation capital that cannot be instantly created or migrated. The trust infrastructure — verified profiles, payment escrow, host insurance — took a decade to build and is deeply embedded in global travel booking.

challengers.name: AI travel planning assistants with direct booking
challengers.evidence: Google's travel AI and startups like Layla and Mindtrip can plan and recommend accommodations using AI, potentially abstracting Airbnb's discovery layer behind an AI interface that selects listings autonomously.
